test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 08 Feb 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

I were / writing / this poem / last evening.
solution:
Here, the erroneous part is "I were."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The error lies in the usage of the word "were."
 
• The error in the sentence is a subject-verb agreement issue.
 
• In this correction,** "were" **is changed to** "was" **to match the singular subject** "I."**
 
• **"Was" **is the correct past tense form of the verb **"to be"** when used with the singular pronoun **"I."**
 
• 
 
Hence, option 1 is the correct answer.

 

Correct sentence: ***I was**__ writing this poem last evening.*
